subject: Venue droppoint, on-site split and overnight personalization plan
messages:
From: Karen Lee <karen@bluebirdpromo.com>
To: hiro_tanaka@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: DevCon — split shipment + personalization options (quote attached)

Hi Hiro,

Thanks for the call this morning. Attached is our updated quote (Bluebird_quote_v4.pdf) reflecting:
- split fulfillment: 1,200 general kits to be pallet-shipped to the main warehouse, 300 VIP kits to be routed to the hotel concierge.
- overnight personalization for 150 VIP lanyards (embroidered names) to be completed the night before the show and delivered to the venue droppoint at 06:00 on Aug 10.
- per-unit cost includes a one-time set-up fee for the embroidery template.

A few open items we need confirmed by COB Monday so we can lock production and transit:
1) Final VIP list for names (CSV).
2) Venue droppoint contact and receiving hours (do we use the official DevCon dock or hotel concierge?).
3) Approval on the additional rush fee for overnight personalization.

If you want, Samir at Express Kitting can handle the last-mile drop & on-site staging — they already have access to DevCon zones. I’ve looped him in.

Best,
Karen

--
Karen Lee
Account Manager, Bluebird Promo Co.
[attachment: Bluebird_quote_v4.pdf]

From: hiro_tanaka@redwood.com
To: Karen Lee <karen@bluebirdpromo.com>, Samir Patel <samir@expresskitting.co>, Alex Morales <alex@devconconf.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: DevCon — split shipment + personalization options (quote attached)

Karen / Samir / Alex,

Thanks — received and reviewed. Quick answers to your open items:
1) VIP CSV: attached to this thread (VIP_names_final.csv) — 146 names, please plan for +4 spares to account for badge swaps.
2) Use the DevCon official dock. Contact at receiving is Jorge Ramos (vendor receiving) — Jorge accepts deliveries 05:30–08:00 and will provide a 10x10 staging area.
3) We approve the overnight rush fee — confirm final total once you lock the embroidery run.

Two important constraints from our ops side:
- We cannot have any decorative pins or hard-items packed inside the personalized lanyard pouches (security screening at the dock flagged past shipments). Keep the VIP kits laminated ID + lanyard + printed welcome only.
- If Express Kitting will do on-site staging, they must be able to provide a signed manifest at handoff for DevCon security.

Samir — can you confirm your team can be on-site for the 06:00 handoff and provide a manned cart + 2 people for distribution?

Thanks,
Hiro

[attachment: VIP_names_final.csv]

Hi team,

We can cover the 06:00 handoff and provide the manifest. Confirmed resources: 3-person crew (lead + 2 handlers) and a battery cart. We’ll produce a venue_drop_manifest_0809.xlsx that includes pallet IDs, box counts, and the VIP subset flagged for the concierge.

A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Bluebird should label VIP boxes with "PRIORITY—PERSONALIZATION" and include a separate packing list inside each VIP box that lists the names contained in that box.
- For the overnight embroidery, we need the approved font/abbreviation list — e.g., no diacritics beyond ASCII unless you confirm. Any last-minute accented characters may incur rework.

Karen — once the embroidery is run, can Bluebird upload a photo proof of five random embroidered lanyards for QA before sending the VIP pallet?

Samir

Great — thanks for the confirmations. A few final asks before we greenlight: 
1) Karen: please send the final invoice line for the overnight personalization (we'll need it for PO).
2) Samir: please include the security handoff column in the manifest with space for Jorge's signature.
3) Marissa / Vanessa: please confirm you’re ok with the pared-back VIP kit contents (lanyard + laminated card + welcome sheet) so Bluebird can proceed without packing extras that may fail security screening.

If everyone confirms before 11:00 PDT tomorrow we’ll sign off and route the PO. We really appreciate the quick turnaround on this.
